utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — what time does the repair drive start on Sunday, and do you still need anything else dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It starts at 9 on Sunday, and we could still use a few more screws and some clean rags. If you can drop them off, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, I can drop those off. What address should I bring them to on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep sharing the repair drive details and remind everyone to bring what they can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you need the address, the time, or both for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Both would be great — I’ll share the full repair drive details and keep reminding everyone to bring what they can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I’m still trying to keep track of what’s needed for the repair drive. If you have the address or time handy, that’d help me a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh sure — I still don’t have the address or time pinned down yet, but I’m keeping an ear out and I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — that helps. I’ll keep an eye out too, and if anything else gets pinned down for the repair drive, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s Sunday at the community center now. I’ll send the address along so everyone can find it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great — thanks. What kind of help do they still need most once folks get there?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly help with the repair list and keeping the timing on track. I’ll send the details so folks know where to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — could you send the address and time when you have them? That’ll help me keep everything organized for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the address and time as soon as I have them. Thanks for keeping everything organized for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. Just send it over when you have it, and I’ll keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still missing the address for the repair drive — where’s it being held again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure of the address yet, but I can check and get it to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. Just send me the address when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help — what info do you need about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I still need the address and the exact details for the repair drive before I can go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s at the community center on Sunday, but I still need the full address and any other key details before I send it over.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — that covers it. I’ll send the details over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo — I’ll keep the tools ready and bring them over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, Gus — much appreciated. I’ll send the repair drive details soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: The repair drive’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I’m spreading the update around. Who should I invite first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — please start with the parents and anyone coordinating the school schedule. I can help spread the word once I have the full details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start with the parents and school schedule folks right away. If you hear of anyone else I should loop in, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m headed over now to check the community center lot, and I’ll confirm the location as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — I’ll wait for your confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m at the community center lot now, and it looks like the repair drive is here. I’ll confirm anything else if I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got batteries, duct tape, and a couple more volunteers on the list for the repair drive. What else do you still need, Kira?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we know the address and time for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet — I’m still checking on the address and time. I’ll let you know as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with setup and greeting at the door on Sunday at the community center. Just let me know what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — that’s a big help. Please be there by 1:00 so we can get set up before folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll be there by 1:00 on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still piecing together the repair drive details, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — just send me the list of needed tools, parts, and volunteer times when you have them, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll send over the tools, parts, and volunteer times as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we have the address and time confirmed yet? I just want to make sure I’m heading to the right place.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’d check both before you go—last I heard, they were still confirming the address and time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — so it’s still not confirmed yet? I’ll wait for the address and time before heading over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have the address yet, and I’m still waiting on the repair drive details. If you send them over, I can check the start time too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have the details yet either — I’m waiting on the address and start time. If you get them, please send them over and I’ll help keep track of anything else needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — I’m still waiting too, and I’ll send the address and start time as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you have the address or time for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not yet — I’m waiting on the lot check, and I’ll send the repair drive details as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Okay, I’ll keep an eye out for the lot check and the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sorry, I’m a bit behind — what address is the repair drive at again?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It’s at the community center on Sunday now — want me to check what still needs covering?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yes please — I’m still catching up, so could you tell me what still needs covering?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send the final repair drive details shortly — tools, spare parts, and volunteer help for small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — that covers it well. I’ll keep reminding folks about Sunday at the community center and ask them to bring any small tools or spare parts they can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks Rosa — I’ll send the details over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ve got those marked as covered. What else should I put on the list for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up from second-hand updates, so what area needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’d start with the roof patch and a quick check on the front steps — those seem most urgent right now. I’ll keep updating the supply list as we hear what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep everyone posted that it’s now Sunday at the community center. Who do you want me to invite first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s start with the folks who already offered help: Dane, Gus, and Ira. I’d keep it simple and send them the time, place, and a short list of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it — I’ll message Dane, Gus, and Ira with the Sunday community center update and the remaining needs. I’ll keep it short and clear.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll send the repair drive details right over now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara — that helps. I’ll keep it low-key and let you know if I hear anyone who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — thanks, Uli. I’ll send the repair drive details now, and we can add anyone who’s able to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m on it, Bo — I’ll send the repair drive details as soon as I confirm them. It should include the tools, spare parts, and any volunteer help we’ve got lined up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam — just send the repair drive details when you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got them now, Bo — I’ll send over the repair drive details with the tools, spare parts, and volunteer help.
